questions.q: What is an External ID field?
options: A system field Salesforce creates automatically on every object
A custom field flagged with the External ID attribute, usable as a match key for Upsert
The Salesforce record ID, renamed for clarity
A field that only exists on the Account object
questions.explain: An External ID is a custom Text, Number, or Email field with the External ID attribute checked, which lets Upsert use it as a match key instead of the record ID.

questions.q: Why does upserting on an External ID make repeated loads from the same source idempotent?
options: Because Upsert deletes the file after one successful run
Because running the same file again updates existing matches instead of creating duplicates
Because External ID fields expire after 24 hours
Because Data Loader caches the first run's results and skips the second run entirely
questions.explain: On a second run, rows that already matched an existing record update it rather than inserting a new one — so the same file can be loaded repeatedly without creating duplicates.

questions.q: How do you load Contacts linked to their Account using only the Account's legacy identifier, without looking up Salesforce IDs by hand?
options: It isn't possible — you must always look up the Account's Salesforce ID manually first
Map a column using dot notation, like Account.Legacy_Customer_Number__c, to the Account lookup field
Create a separate CSV for every Account and import them one at a time
Use the Account's Name field as the only way to establish the relationship
questions.explain: Dot notation (RelatedObject.ExternalIdField) lets Data Loader resolve the relationship using the parent's External ID value, with no manual Salesforce ID lookup needed.

questions.q: What happens during an Upsert if the External ID field being matched on is NOT marked Unique, and two records share the same value?
options: Salesforce picks the most recently modified record automatically
The row is updated on both matching records simultaneously
The row fails, since there are two ambiguous candidates and no safe way to guess
The field's Unique setting has no effect on Upsert behavior
questions.explain: Without uniqueness, an ambiguous match causes that row to fail rather than guess — which is why a non-unique External ID field is the most common cause of a job that silently skips or duplicates rows.

questions.q: Which field types can be flagged as an External ID?
options: Only Text fields
Text, Number, or Email fields
Only lookup relationship fields
Any field type, including rich text and long text area
questions.explain: Salesforce allows the External ID attribute on Text, Number, or Email custom fields.
